annotations.title: Create auto-reply on template button click

description: Create a bot that reacts when a contact taps a quick-reply BUTTON on a template you sent (e.g. after a campaign). For each button give the reply (template or text) — perfect for 'when they click X, send Y'. The button title must match the template's button exactly.

buttons.description: One entry per button to handle.

button.description: The button title exactly as on the template.

templateName.description: The template whose buttons are being clicked.
